title: Begin with curiosity
placement: Everyday example, before the practice notebook
proposal: A colleague pauses; the group begins to move on; a facilitator asks whether time or another response format would help. Show the observation separately from proposed interpretations.
purpose: Turn the existing pause example into a usable observation-and-inquiry practice.
learnerAction: Write an observation, two plausible explanations and one respectful question.
readiness: The notebook exists. Add described stills alongside the example; a spoken or animated version needs a player and timed text.
basis: The source asks learners to separate an observed pause from assumptions about its meaning.
accessibleEquivalent: Full action description and dialogue, with the same untimed practice questions.

title: Make room for different experiences
proposal: Show a meeting with only rapid spoken contributions, then the same question shared in advance with quiet thinking time and written responses.
purpose: Show why an identical invitation can create different participation conditions.
learnerAction: Revise one participation approach and explain whose perspective would help evaluate it.
readiness: Use a shared meeting scene; the journey still needs a media slot.
basis: The source contrasts the same opportunity to speak with different ways people can contribute.
accessibleEquivalent: Ordered descriptions of both arrangements and all discussion questions.

title: Adapt how you communicate
proposal: A visitor says the explanation is difficult to follow. Compare repetition with a question about what would help, a written summary and a check of the next task.
purpose: Make communication adaptation visible as a response to a stated need.
learnerAction: Create a revised explanation and a concrete way to check whether it helped.
readiness: Existing practice supports the response; lesson video and captions require new delivery support.
basis: The example identifies clearer questions, written summaries, accessible information and qualified language support.
accessibleEquivalent: Complete dialogue and actions, with equivalent text choices and feedback.

title: Carry learning into a decision
proposal: Trace a fictional renewal notice through understanding, document gathering and response. Compare clearer wording with an option that also removes unnecessary steps.
purpose: Connect a communication issue to the surrounding process and an open decision.
learnerAction: Draft an option with evidence, affected perspectives, responsibilities and remaining questions.
readiness: Text tools exist; add an accessible companion diagram.
basis: The example explicitly moves from unclear notices to documentation burden, formats and required response steps.
accessibleEquivalent: Full notice text and an ordered process table.

title: Learn from what happens next
proposal: Show more written ideas arriving, then separately show which ideas influenced the decision and what feedback remains missing.
purpose: Distinguish participation activity from evidence of influence.
learnerAction: Write what changed, what is still unknown and the next adjustment.
readiness: Use semantic tables and existing reflection fields.
basis: The source says more ideas do not alone establish greater influence.
accessibleEquivalent: Same labeled values and accounts in a readable table.

title: Equity Analysis Toolkit companion
placement: Reminder decision and existing choice feedback
proposal: Map the existing reminder choices: mail, text, shared-phone access, language preferences, alternate formats and responsibility for a usable response.
purpose: Help staff see how a decision changes benefits, burdens and responsibilities.
learnerAction: Complete the companion draft with an option, the reasoning and a follow-up question.
readiness: Companion choices exist; add a diagram synchronized with their actual text. Preserve the original toolkit requirements.
basis: The existing companion uses five stages and a fictional reminder decision.
accessibleEquivalent: All nodes, links, choices and consequences in an ordered text version.

title: Community engagement: from input to action
placement: Fictional employment-learning example: activity, influence, result, return
proposal: Show the original weekday online session, stated access and timing barriers, revised response options and a report of what changed.
purpose: Show the connection between participation, influence, action and reporting back.
learnerAction: Develop a participation and report-back plan tied to an open choice.
readiness: Four text panels exist; add a visual companion without replacing them.
basis: The source separates activity, influence, result and return in its fictional example.
accessibleEquivalent: Four numbered text panels with identical content and links.

title: Operationalizing equity — participation in meetings
proposal: Show agenda input before a meeting, several ways to contribute during it and a short account of how input shaped the decision afterward.
purpose: Make the program definition concrete through one everyday practice.
learnerAction: Choose a participation change and how colleagues will hear what happened to their input.
readiness: The example and practice link exist; add a reusable scene companion.
basis: The source asks who shapes the agenda, which formats help contribution and how contributions influence decisions.
accessibleEquivalent: Complete descriptions plus the existing example and questions.

title: Operationalizing equity — forms and service processes
proposal: Show what a fictional person must understand, provide and do, then compare options that reduce an identified burden while retaining necessary requirements.
purpose: Connect equity analysis to the steps of a service rather than awareness alone.
learnerAction: Identify a process question to explore with people who use the service.
readiness: Use a readable comparison linked to the existing toolkit companion.
basis: The example names language, disability access, technology and documentation burdens.
accessibleEquivalent: Accessible original/revised form text and process table.

title: Operationalizing equity — workplace opportunities
proposal: Follow a fictional learning opportunity from announcement through criteria, expression of interest, participation support and feedback.
purpose: Make access to development opportunities visible and discussable.
learnerAction: Identify a communication, criterion or support question for an opportunity in the work.
readiness: Add an HTML diagram linked to current leadership resources.
basis: The example asks how opportunities are communicated, criteria shaping access and support for participation.
accessibleEquivalent: Same steps and questions in an ordered list.

title: One DHS program home
media: Reuse existing hero and compact visual invitations
proposal: Keep the approved still hero. Use the existing Learn, Practice and Connect invitations to point to relevant learning examples rather than adding another promotional video.
purpose: Maintain a clear, welcoming entry with useful choices.
learnerAction: Choose a resource, practical activity or colleague connection.
readiness: Existing image and links work as the entry format; substantive new media belongs at the destination.
basis: Home already offers Learn and explore, Put equity into practice and Connect with colleagues.
accessibleEquivalent: Existing text links and meaningful hero alternative text.

title: About — our connection to DHS
proposal: Connect the program, DHS knowledge, DSD practice and appropriate support using the source-backed relationships already described.
purpose: Help readers understand what the resource program connects.
learnerAction: Open Understanding DHS for the responsibility relevant to their question.
readiness: Keep one maintained diagram reused from orientation; no new organization hierarchy inferred.
basis: The section connects programs, partners, responsibilities and everyday decisions.
accessibleEquivalent: Equivalent linked list of relationships.

title: Start
placement: New here, or taking a fresh look?
proposal: Offer the same concise orientation map beside the existing invitation, with every program door still directly available.
purpose: Help someone find a useful starting point without a required sequence.
learnerAction: Choose a destination based on a current question.
readiness: Reuse the proposed orientation asset once authored; avoid a separate duplicate welcome.
basis: The page explicitly invites new and returning colleagues to orientation.
accessibleEquivalent: All destinations remain visible text links.

title: Learning and resources
proposal: Keep real course covers and make actual audio discoverable. Use a short tool preview only where it helps distinguish similar resources.
purpose: Help visitors select learning that fits what they want to do.
learnerAction: Open a course or tool with a relevant application.
readiness: Covers and introduction audio exist; do not label a text exercise as playable video.
basis: The catalog combines courses, resources, podcast surfaces and practice paths.
accessibleEquivalent: Titles, purposes and format labels remain text; audio needs accurate transcripts.

title: Library
proposal: Show a readable small preview of the actual checklist or worksheet, linked to its complete usable version.
purpose: Help people recognize the work product a resource supports.
learnerAction: Open and adapt the resource.
readiness: Directory exists; resource media preview fields require additional support.
basis: The shared library lists scoped resources and published courses.
accessibleEquivalent: Resource title, summary and direct link without relying on thumbnail text.

title: ASK — resource recommendations
proposal: For a meeting question, link the relevant participation scene and its complete transcript alongside the substantive answer and meeting tool.
purpose: Let a question lead to an example and useful next action.
learnerAction: Explore the recommended example or use its practical tool.
readiness: ASK reliability work remains deferred. Media metadata and exact transcript links need implementation before these answers can be verified.
basis: ASK already responds to questions and provides program resource routes.
accessibleEquivalent: The answer and resource text must remain complete without playing media.

title: Learning for your work
proposal: When a colleague chooses a notice-related task, show the annotated notice example beside the actual plain-language resource and practice link.
purpose: Connect a current task to useful learning and a work product.
learnerAction: Open the resource and revise a sample notice.
readiness: Task/resource selection exists; adding course coverage and media preview metadata is separate work.
basis: The current page filters a scoped resource snapshot by role and task.
accessibleEquivalent: Full resource labels, summary and links with the same example in HTML.

title: My Work
proposal: Let a fictional worked example show an original meeting plan, one change and a short reflection; the learner keeps their own notes through existing controls.
purpose: Show how a learning activity can become a change and a later reflection.
learnerAction: Compare what they intended, tried and observed.
readiness: Private device notes exist; no persistent media portfolio is implied.
basis: The page combines current learning, course lessons and working notes.
accessibleEquivalent: Selectable text for both versions and reflection.

title: Find the right person
proposal: For a revised appointment notice, show the question that belongs with communications, the question for access support and the program resource that helps prepare.
purpose: Clarify why each recommended destination is relevant.
learnerAction: Carry a focused question to the appropriate existing route.
readiness: Existing routing must generate both diagram and text from the same result.
basis: The tool uses task, role, work area and urgency to suggest sourced destinations.
accessibleEquivalent: The complete ordered recommendation list remains available.

title: Share a result
proposal: Show an example that separates a revised reminder, what was observed, who responded, missing perspectives and the next question.
purpose: Help people describe experience without turning a personal account into a verified causal result.
learnerAction: Prepare an action, observed result and follow-up account.
readiness: Form fields exist; add an optional worked example. No recorder or upload capability is implied.
basis: The form asks for action, adopted change, observed result, follow-up and sharing choice.
accessibleEquivalent: Full text and evidence table matching the example.

title: DHS equity policy and toolkit — podcast
media: Reuse audio with transcript and chapter navigation
proposal: Add a verified transcript and selectable topic chapters that lead to the corresponding toolkit companion activity.
purpose: Make the existing long-form discussion easier to revisit and apply.
learnerAction: Open a relevant analysis activity after listening or reading.
readiness: Audio exists. Player transcript and chapter fields need adding; exact chapter times require listening and verification.
basis: The source registers the approved toolkit podcast at this location.
accessibleEquivalent: Accurate complete transcript and meaningful topic links.

title: Anti-racism in public service — podcast
media: Reuse audio with described excerpt companions
proposal: Identify an actual segment relevant to a practice question, add its verified transcript and link to a reflection or optional Amplify discussion.
purpose: Connect listening to voluntary dialogue and application.
learnerAction: Bring a question to a conversation or develop one practical adjustment.
readiness: Audio exists; select and verify exact excerpts before assigning timestamps.
basis: The source registers the approved anti-racism podcast in Learning.
accessibleEquivalent: Complete transcript and the same discussion question.
